messages:
Aisha: FYI customer reported SSO failures right after their IdP cert rotation. They get a 403 on callback and SAML log shows Recipient/ACS mismatch. Pasting the trace we got: 
```
<samlp:Response Destination="https://app.acme.example/saml/consume" ...>
  <saml:Assertion>
    <saml:SubjectConfirmationData Recipient="https://app.acme.example/saml/consume/"/>
  </saml:Assertion>
</samlp:Response>
```
Aisha: Note the trailing slash in the SubjectConfirmationData Recipient vs SP's configured ACS (no trailing slash).
Priya: Can you paste the IdP metadata blob they provided (or a minimal excerpt)? specifically KeyDescriptor/order and AssertionConsumerService entries.
Aisha: Minimal excerpt from their metadata: 
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.acme.example">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>
    <KeyDescriptor use="signing">
      <KeyInfo><X509Data><X509Certificate>MIIC...NEWCERT</X509Certificate></X509Data></KeyInfo>
    </KeyDescriptor>
    <KeyDescriptor use="signing">
      <KeyInfo><X509Data><X509Certificate>MIIC...OLDCERT</X509Certificate></X509Data></KeyInfo>
    </KeyDescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://app.acme.example/saml/consume" index="0" isDefault="true"/>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://app.acme.example/saml/consume/" index="1"/>
  </IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Carlos: Looks like two ACS entries (one with trailing slash). Our SP validates Recipient strictly against configured ACS list; trailing-slash variant doesn't match. Also there are two KeyDescriptor entries — order might influence which cert the SP chooses for signature validation.
Tom: Quick diagnostics to ask customer: 
- run `curl -sS https://idp.acme.example/metadata | xmllint --format -` to confirm metadata headers 
- grab the raw SAMLResponse (base64) and decode: `echo $SAMLRESP | base64 -d | xmllint --format -` 
Maya: Temporary workaround: add the trailing-slash ACS URL as an alias in their SP config (both entries) or normalize incoming Recipient before validation. That usually restores logins immediately. :thumbsup:
Aisha: Customer added the alias and logins worked for ~12 minutes, then failed again. Error now is: `AssertionConsumerService URL not permitted for SP` in our logs.
Priya: That suggests metadata cache incoherence or metadata poller fetching a different version (maybe their IdP served a cached metadata with only one ACS after the rotate). Check our metadata-poller logs and ETag handling.
devops-bot: metadata-poller: fetched metadata for idp.acme.example at 2024-05-10T11:23:45Z (ETag: W/"v32"), entries: 1 ACS, 2 KeyDescriptor.
Carlos: If poller saw 1 ACS then our config would only allow the no-slash URL. If their SAML responses briefly used the slash URL (or vice versa) due to mixed frontends, you'll get intermittent failures.
Tom: Also confirm the IdP's signed XML uses the same cert that's first in KeyDescriptor list. Some SP implementations pick the first cert to validate and fail if ordering changed. Ask them to keep the new cert first or include both and ensure signature matches either cert.
Aisha: Customer ran `openssl x509 -in new.pem -noout -fingerprint -sha256` and confirmed fingerprint matches the cert in the first KeyDescriptor. They still see intermittent fails.
Priya: Next steps: 
1) ask customer to enable SAML debug logging or provide raw SAMLResponse for failed attempt; look for which ACS URL is in SubjectConfirmationData. 
2) Have them publish metadata under a new URL and set a short TTL, then force our poller to refetch (we can trigger via support console). 
3) If needed, we can temporarily relax strict Recipient matching for that SP while they finish rotation (requires SOC approval).
Carlos: Short command to re-fetch and show headers for us: `curl -I https://idp.acme.example/metadata` and `curl -s https://idp.acme.example/metadata | xmllint --xpath 'string(//AssertionConsumerService[@isDefault])' -`
Maya: I'll reach out to infra to bump poller immediate re-sync for this tenant and log it in the incident ticket.
Aisha: Thanks — I've attached their support case ID #11342 and uploaded the failing SAMLResponse. Escalating to oncall (Tom) if we need to change SP validation temporarily.
Tom: Oncall acked — I'll join the call with customer at 11:45. Meanwhile, customer, please capture a failed SAMLResponse and include the exact Recipient value. That will tell us which variant to allow.
Aisha: Will do. :white_check_mark:
